slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 「欢迎来到费伦大陆，dnd系统已经解锁，助您书写龙与地下城的传说！」
年轻男人睁开眼，发现自己躺在简陋的营火旁，环顾四周，是昏暗静谧的树林。
这是哪？
轰隆！
一声惊雷落下，将夜幕照亮，林间斑驳的阴影中，仿佛有一个巨大的身影掠过，不一会儿，远处传来一声沉闷的龙吟。
这是……龙吗？
刚刚他说费伦大陆……难道我真的穿越了，这是龙与地下城背景下的世界？
“终于醒啦小子。”
突然在身后响起的粗旷声音让年轻男人瞬间警觉起来，他赶忙转头，只见一个猎户打扮的糙汉。
“小子，这是什么眼神，这么提防我干什么？知不知道是我救了你！要不是我在湖边捡到昏迷不醒的你，好心带回营地，你这小崽子早就被鱼人撕成碎片了！”
猎户大叔看见年轻男人那怀疑的眼神很不爽，吹胡子瞪眼地输出一大通。
“所以你是哪里人？怎么会一个人昏倒在水晶湖？”
dnd世界观下有鱼人吗？他还真不记得了。
年轻男人一边想着，一边如喝水一般平常地撒了个谎：“额，我从博德之门过来，叫我艾岚就好。”
“噢！艾伦（allen）！听起来像个贵族，博德之门又是哪，你怎么会跑到我们这来？”
噢，不知道博德之门的乡下人。
“艾伦”一边想着，一边观察猎户，突然，一个温柔却空洞的女性嗓音，毫无征兆地在他耳畔响起，清晰得仿佛有人贴着耳朵低语。
「洞悉检定：19点，成功」
「一个看起来人畜无害的“人类”猎户，即使丢失了大部分的记忆，但你仍敏锐地注意到，她那看似和蔼的外表下，是难以掩饰的傲慢。」
这个人有问题！
艾伦立刻提起警惕，但他只听到声音，不知道系统说的是“女”字旁的她。
在dnd游戏中，会有各种各样的掷骰子检定，只要投掷20面骰子的点数达标，就能达成不同的效果。
比如，通过洞悉检定能识破他人言语上的欺骗或伪装。
所以，在系统“洞悉检定”的剧透下，艾伦可以确定面前这位猎户大叔绝对没有那么简单。
难以掩饰的傲慢......所以此人可能有着显赫的身份，现在只是伪装。
当然，艾伦并没有在脸上表现出来，他满怀感激地开口：“噢！先生！真是太感谢你了，我来此地省亲，却遭遇了一群该死的强盗，他们将我洗劫一空就丢在那不管死活，真是该死！”
猎户点了点头：“最近冒出来的这伙红头巾确实招人讨厌。”
艾伦的感激之情也不全是伪装出来的，不管此人是什么身份，救了刚穿越昏迷的他总归是事实，“万分感谢，游侠先生，请问能否告知在下您的姓名，我一定会牢记这份恩情。”
我记得，dnd世界观下的猎人应该是叫游侠吧？
艾伦这么想着，却没注意到猎户在听见“游侠”二字后瞳孔微缩。
‘游侠，他怎么知道我是游侠？！’
但猎户快速掩饰自己的失态，憨厚大笑：“温雷，叫我温雷就好，你昏迷这么久，饿坏了吧。”

;;
"Welcome to the continent of Faerûn. The dnd system has been unlocked to help you write the legend of Dungeons and Dragons!"
The young man opened his eyes and found himself lying next to a simple campfire. Looking around, he saw the dark and quiet woods.
Where is this?
Boom!
A thunder fell, illuminating the night. In the mottled shadows of the forest, a huge figure seemed to pass by. After a while, a dull dragon roar came from the distance.
Is this...a dragon?
He just talked about the continent of Faerûn... Could it be that I really traveled through time and this is a world in the context of Dungeons and Dragons?
"Finally woke up, kid."
The sudden rough voice behind him made the young man instantly alert. He quickly turned around and saw a rough man dressed as a hunter.
"Boy, what's that look in your face? Why are you so wary of me? Do you know that I saved you! If I hadn't picked you up unconscious by the lake and kindly brought you back to the camp, you little brat would have been torn to pieces by the fish-men!"
Uncle Orion was very unhappy when he saw the suspicious look in the young man's eyes, and he blew his beard and glared.
"So where are you from? How come you passed out alone in Crystal Lake?"
Are there fishmen in the DND worldview? He really doesn't remember.
While the young man was thinking about it, he lied as normally as if he were drinking water: "Well, I came from Baldur's Gate, just call me Ai Lan."
"Oh! Allen! You sound like a noble. Where is Baldur's Gate? Why did you come to us?"
Oh, rednecks who don't know Baldur's Gate.
"Alan" was thinking while observing Orion. Suddenly, a gentle but hollow female voice sounded in his ear without warning, as clear as if someone was whispering against his ear.
"Insight check: 19 points, successful"
"A seemingly harmless "human" hunter, even though she has lost most of her memory, you are still keenly aware of the arrogance that cannot be concealed beneath her seemingly amiable appearance."
There is something wrong with this person!
Allen immediately became vigilant, but he only heard the voice and did not know that the system was referring to her next to the word "female".
In the dnd game, there will be various dice rolling tests. As long as the points of throwing 20-sided dice reach the standard, different effects can be achieved.
For example, an Insight check can detect deception or pretense in someone else's words.
Therefore, under the spoiler of the system's "Insight Check", Allen can be sure that the Uncle Orion in front of him is definitely not that simple.
Unmistakable arrogance...so this person may have had a distinguished identity and is now just pretending.
Of course, Allen didn't show it on his face. He said with gratitude: "Oh! Sir! Thank you so much. I came here to visit my relatives, but I encountered a group of damn robbers. They robbed me and left me there to care about life or death. Damn it!"
Orion nodded: "The group of red turbans that have popped up recently are really annoying."
Allen's gratitude is not entirely disguised. No matter what the identity of this person is, it is always a fact that he saved him who just passed through a coma. "Thank you very much, Mr. Ranger. Could you tell me your name? I will definitely remember this kindness."
I remember, the hunter in the DND world should be called a ranger, right?
Allen was thinking this, but he didn't notice that Orion's pupils shrank slightly after hearing the word "Ranger".
‘Ranger, how did he know I was a ranger? ! ’
But Orion quickly covered up his gaffe and laughed honestly: "Wen Lei, just call me Wen Lei. You must be starving after being comatose for so long."
